meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE whenever a task needs a commit or git-history investigation. Covers atomic commits, staging, commit-message style, rebase, squash, fixup/autosquash, blame, bisect, reflog, git log -S/-G, and questions like who wrote this or when was this added. Do not use for ordinary code edits unless the user asks for git work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交与历史，自动生成规范提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范提交或排查 Git 历史
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits and history with automated commit messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to make clean commits or investigate Git history

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 处理 Git 提交或历史排查时,会先检查仓库状态,再按提交、变基、历史、状态四类操作处理;提交时按原子变更分组并沿用仓库现有提交信息风格,最后报告提交哈希和未提交文件。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交代码、调查Git历史(如谁改过、何时添加),或用户明确要求Git操作时触发;普通代码编辑且未提Git时不启用。

say.text: 帮我把当前的改动拆成两个原子提交
say.note: 它会分析改动并按主题分组提交。

say.text: 查一下这行是谁最后改的
say.note: 它会用 git blame 定位并展示提交信息。

say.text: 把最近三个提交压缩成一个
say.note: 它会执行交互式变基并合并提交。

howto.what_en: Claude inspects the repo state for commit or history tasks, then chooses from four modes: commit, rebase, history, status. It groups changes into atomic commits, matches repo message style, and reports hashes and uncommitted files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task needs a commit or git-history investigation, or when the user explicitly asks for git work. Not used for ordinary code edits unless git is mentioned.

say_en.text: Split my current changes into two atomic commits.
say_en.note: It analyzes the diff and groups by topic.
It uses git blame to show the commit.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.
